evidence.detail: The render method walks the complete DrawingArea software surface using the float depth buffer and destination pixel buffer in lockstep.

Pixels beyond the configured far threshold are replaced with the configured fog color; pixels inside the start/end depth range are alpha-blended toward that fog color using distance-derived intensity.
The class owns only fog color/intensity state plus one float range offset and exposes setters for both before rendering; it owns no scene geometry, texture or unrelated gameplay state.
Public RSPS client lineage contains the same depth-buffer algorithm under renderFog-style rasterizer code, independently corroborating a depth-fog rendering role.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the software depth-buffer fog pass. The original stripped identifier is not claimed.
